data.name: Reemsha
data.gender_notes: Reemsha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Reemsha is derived from the Arabic word 'Reem' which means 'dew' and 'Sha' which means 'night'. So, Reemsha means 'Night Dew'. This name is often given to girls born during the rainy season as a symbol of beauty and grace. The name Reemsha carries the meaning “Night Dew” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Reemsha usually hope their child will grow to embody night dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reemsha is a spiritual name that symbolizes the blessings of Allah (SWT) in the form of night dew. It reminds us of the blessings we receive in our lives, no matter how small they may seem.
data.etymology: Reemsha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night Dew.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Reemsha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
